practicals.title: Practical-1
content: Study and explore AI tools and identify their applications in
engineering domains

content: Compare AI tools with traditional methods for solving engineering
tasks.

content: Design and use effective prompts for communication with AI tools

content: Analyze AI-generated outputs to identify errors and improve
responses

bias

content: Design structured prompts using task, context, and output format

and example-based prompting

content: Develop prompt templates for report, checklist, and SOP

practicals.title: Practical-9
content: Test and refine prompts to improve output quality

practicals.title: Practical-10
content: Generate inspection checklist, maintenance procedure, and safety
instructions using AI

practicals.title: Practical-11
content: Generate structured outputs (tables/reports) and compare multiple
AI outputs

practicals.title: Practical-12
content: Design workflow-based prompts for routine engineering tasks

practicals.title: Practical-13
content: Identify and verify incorrect AI outputs and apply prompt chaining

practicals.title: Practical-14
content: Develop a mini project using prompt engineering for real-world
problem solving
